settings.title: OBD-II & indicator source

options.title: Real OBD brake lamp when connected, HMG-API model otherwise (Recommended)
HMG-API model drives icon (live accuracy & lag test vs OBD)

settings.description: Connects via HMG-API's built-in @hmgapi-ble BLE central (hmgapi.client.Ble), automatically yielding to 127.0.0.1:35000 when obd-gen5w's ELM327 bridge is active so AT headers never collide. Both OBD modes log synchronized HMG-API + OBD ground-truth rows in RAM for USB CSV export.

settings.title: HMG-API brake model mode

options.title: Brake pressure + Regen / Smart Cruise deceleration & hold (Recommended)

settings.description: Recommended mode combines HMG-API brake.pressure with longitudinal speed deceleration and standstill hold so Level 2/3 regen, i-Pedal, and Smart Cruise Control illuminate the indicator without OBD.

settings.title: When brake lights are off
settings.description: Controls whether the top-bar icon disappears completely or stays faintly visible as a dark-grey outline when unlit.

settings.title: Top-bar horizontal anchor
settings.description: Selects which edge of the top row x_offset is measured from.

settings.title: Horizontal offset (px)
settings.description: Distance in pixels from the anchor (for Top center, signed offset from center). Default 260 sits cleanly to the left of the clock and status icons on 1920x720 screens.

settings.title: Vertical offset from top (px)
settings.description: Distance in pixels from the top edge of the screen.

settings.title: Icon height (px)
settings.description: Height of the top-bar brake lamp icon in pixels (20 to 96; stock Gen5W status icons are 36 px tall).

settings.title: Brake pressure threshold (tenths)
settings.description: Minimum HMG-API brake.pressure reading in tenths (4 = 0.4) to treat foot-pedal or IEB hydraulic braking as active.

settings.title: Regen / cruise deceleration threshold (tenths of m/s^2)
settings.description: Minimum longitudinal deceleration in tenths of m/s^2 (12 = 1.2 m/s^2, matching E-GMP UNECE R13-H stop-lamp onset) when Regen / Smart Cruise detection is enabled.

settings.title: Hold at standstill after regen / cruise / Auto-Hold stop
settings.description: Keeps the HMG-API model illuminated at 0 km/h after decelerating to a stop under Auto-Hold, i-Pedal, or Smart Cruise Control until throttle is applied, the car moves, EPB engages, or Park is selected.

settings.title: Auto-export logs to USB (on Park & near-full buffer)
settings.description: Checks whether a FAT32/exFAT USB stick is attached and automatically writes the CSV dataset + calibration summary to <usb>/BrakeIndicator/ when shifting into Park after driving or when the 30-minute RAM buffer reaches 95% capacity, then clears the buffer for a clean next log.

settings.title: Auto-upload logs to GitHub over LTE / Wi-Fi
settings.description: Compresses CSV + summary ~10x into a ~300 KB .tar.gz in RAM and uploads to your private GitHub log repo on Park or 95% buffer once BrakeIndicator/cloud-upload.json has been imported from USB. Falls back to in-RAM queue or USB when offline.

settings.title: Allow cloud log uploads over built-in LTE modem
settings.description: Permits compressed (~300 KB) log uploads over the car's cellular/telematics route (capped at 5 MB/day in RAM). Turn off to upload only over Wi-Fi.

settings.title: Also save USB copy when cloud upload succeeds
settings.description: When enabled and a USB stick is attached, writes plain CSV + summary to <usb>/BrakeIndicator/ in addition to uploading to GitHub.

settings.title: Loopback ELM327 bridge port
settings.description: Localhost TCP port (127.0.0.1) used automatically when obd-gen5w's ELM327 bridge is active so both apps share OBD-II without AT header collisions.
